mainEntity.name: What is the estimated cost of ADU permit coordination services?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of ADU permit coordination services varies based on the scope and complexity of your project. Factors influencing the total include the size and design of the ADU, whether it's a new build or conversion, and the specific requirements of the local jurisdiction. Our service quotes typically cover plan preparation, submission fees, and ongoing communication with city officials to secure approval. We aim to provide clear cost estimates after an initial project assessment.
